root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers on rapid movement or hastening, with a figurative extension to agitated, palpitating motion.
root_idea.development: The lexical range proceeds from speed of travel and causing a mount to hasten to the figurative agitation of hearts.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form IV verb with a normalized perfect-tense citation form.
Distinct Quran-attested active participle/adjectival form describing agitated hearts.

senses.definition: To make a mount or riding force move swiftly; to hasten in travel or make an expedition rapidly.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV use expressing caused rapid movement, including the Quranic construction of making an expedition by means of horses or riding animals.

senses.definition: Palpitating, agitated, or trembling with disturbance.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally in the Quran to describe hearts; the agitation is figuratively likened to rapid or fluttering motion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To urge a horse to run rapidly, thereby making it lean or emaciated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Classical construction describing the effect of driving a horse to excessive speed.
